entities.summary: George Ivar Louis Mountbatten, 4th Marquess of Milford Haven, styled Earl of Medina before 1970, is a British hereditary peer and businessman. George Mountbatten, 4th Marquess of Milford Haven was a performers & entertainers from St Mary's Hospital (b. 1961-06-06, St Mary's Hospital). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
